importedFile.note: Imported unchanged. nonRecipeCodeCells.reason: Notebook variable initialisation. Modelled as the five shared profiles (Hub, Gateway access, Foundry, Key Vault, Policy) rather than a runnable recipe, because it only assigns configuration.

Results summary. It prints the notebook's own `results` dict, which several cells never populate, so the playground reports each recipe's assertions directly instead of reproducing an incomplete roll-up.

excludedScenarios.reason: The source notebook contains no image or multimodal sample. None of its 19 code cells generates, uploads or interprets an image.
The notebook grants LLM APIs and writes an llm-token-limit into the product policy but never sends a completion or chat request.
validate-model-access and the allowed-model list appear in the generated policy but are never exercised.
